content.text: GDK-254 taught the new-issue dialog to ask the origin which fields this project and type require. It warns and submits anyway, because nothing can actually fill them.
- gadak create --help / gadak edit --help offer summary, description, labels, priority, due, parent, attach, type, project. No custom field flag.
- web/src/lib/create-fields.ts:6-7 computes the extra required set and the dialog only shows write.createRequiresMore.
- The read side is already done: GET create-meta/fields/ goes through origin.CreateFields.
- The web detail editor can PATCH custom fields through editmeta, so the capability exists on one surface and not the others.
So on a project with a required Severity or Sprint field, `gadak create` is rejected by Jira and the dialog knowingly submits something it expects to fail.

Fix shape: CLI --field alias=value (alias, not the site's customfield id — display names and raw ids are both traps), the same key accepted in the --batch JSON, and the dialog reusing the option/text/date editors it already has for edit. `gadak api --write` stays the escape hatch, not the answer.

Gate: against a fake whose createmeta page marks a custom field required, create without it must fail and create with --field must succeed; the dialog must stop submitting when a required field it cannot set is missing.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track C, score 9/10).
